summary: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on May 1, 2026, of 12,075,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the over-allotment option, generating $120.75 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one ordinary share, one right to receive one-fourth of an ordinary share at the closing of a business combination, and one warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The underwriter was ARC Group Securities LLC. No specific target or business combination has been announced. The SPAC must complete an initial business combination within a set timeframe; key risk is the ability to find and close a qualifying target, with potential for liquidation if unsuccessful. The trust proceeds remain a key watch item.
